title: ADAB: Arabic Dataset for Automated Politeness Benchmarking - A Large-Scale Resource for Computational Sociopragmatics
reasoning: The paper's framework for Arabic politeness is explicitly grounded in Islamic values and Classical Arabic rhetoric, incorporating concepts from Quranic verses and Prophetic traditions. Additionally, the benchmark evaluates model performance on religious expressions, prayers (Du’ā’), and categories involving discrimination and sectarian attacks.
